one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent never explored the FTP directory structure to find the correct archive paths and instead entered an infinite loop cycling through file extension variants on a wrong base URL, exhausting all 88 steps without obtaining the source code.
t_err_evidence: Step 1 immediately guesses a specific URL path (Old-Versions/unix/povray-2.2.tar.gz) without first exploring the povray.org FTP directory structure, acting on an unverified false premise about the archive location and filename.
t_commit_evidence: At step 28, having tried and silently failed with SourceForge, Debian, GitHub, archive.org, and multiple wget URLs, the agent commits to cycling through file extensions on the same wrong base URL (https://www.povray.org/ftp/pub/povray/Official/Old-Versions/UNIX/povray-2.2.*), from which it never departs for the remaining 60 steps.
t_surface_evidence: Step 7 produces 'gzip: stdin: not in gzip format' and 'tar: Child returned status 1' when attempting to extract the SourceForge-downloaded file, the first visible error signal.
trigger_explanation: The agent assumed from step 1 that the POV-Ray 2.2 source archive would be located at a predictable path under Old-Versions/unix/ (or UNIX/) with a .tar.gz extension, never verifying this assumption by listing the FTP directory. The correct archives (POVSRC.TAR.Z, etc.) are in an 'Official-2.2' subdirectory with non-standard filenames and extensions.
forewarning_evidence: Steps 1-5 and 7-27 collectively show: (1) repeated wget silent failures (empty output) for multiple URL guesses suggesting 404 responses, (2) tar extraction failure at step 7 ('not in gzip format'), and (3) step 10 reveals the downloaded file is an HTML SourceForge page not an archive, all before the commitment at step 28.
